item.title: github: Code scanning AI Scan metrics in security overview
item.description:
Organization and enterprise administrators can now view AI Scan for pull request metrics in the security overview. The new metrics track how many AI Scan findings were generated and resolved, along with related status data.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: Retirement: Pod name dimension in AKS pod platform metrics
item.description:
Azure Monitor is retiring the pod name dimension for certain AKS pod platform metrics starting September 30, 2027. These metrics will move to aggregate pod counters instead.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Logical replication slot sync status metric for Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server now includes a new Azure Monitor metric, logical_replication_slot_sync_status, to track the synchronization status of logical replication slots. It is generally available and lets you monitor whether each logical replication slot is in sync.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: k8s: Kubernetes v1.37: Native Histograms Graduates to Beta
item.description:
Kubernetes v1.37 enables native histogram support for metrics by default and moves the feature to Beta. Components now dual-expose classic buckets and native spans, and users must adjust Prometheus scraping and queries depending on Prometheus version.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Control plane metrics collection for AKS with Managed Prometheus
item.description:
Control plane metrics collection for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with Azure Monitor Managed Service for Prometheus is now generally available. It provides native observability into key managed control plane components.

  • Source: Azure Updates
